mentions.name: blastQR
mentions.description: blastQR is a FOSS, cross-platform app and CLI tool for truly offline file transfers using animated QR code sequences, currently reaching peak transfer speeds of 1.4MB/s. It supports use cases such as large-screen broadcasts so people can receive information during internet blackouts, quick private offline sharing of pictures and small files, air-gapped systems, and airplanes.
mentions.problem: Enables file transfer without internet connectivity, such as during government internet shutdowns or on air-gapped systems.
mentions.audience: People during internet blackouts, everyday users sharing files privately and offline, operators of air-gapped systems, and travelers on airplanes
mentions.source_excerpt: Truly offline file transfers through animated QR code sequences. It's one of the projects I've been working on for the past 2 years: blastQR.
mentions.author: cukha
